artifact.summary: build_circuit(instance) takes a small explicit unitary U on n=1..4 qubits and returns W = Q^T P^T C_U' P Q as an ancilla-free, measurement-free circuit. Q is an XOR-mask basis permutation (X gates). P is a product of basis transpositions found by a greedy search that minimizes a nonzero-off-diagonal-count proxy plus a permutation cost. U' = (PQ)U(PQ)^T is compiled exactly by a two-level (Givens) decomposition into Gray-code-style CX conjugations, multi-controlled U gates and multi-controlled phases. The permutations are compiled to X, CX and multi-controlled X gates. No input state is prepared and nothing is measured.
register_layout: q[0..n-1]: system qubits, little-endian (qubit j holds bit j of basis index k = sum_j b_j 2^j)
Example n=2: q[0] = least significant bit, q[1] = most significant bit
No ancilla qubits; no classical bits

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit (assembly Q^T P^T C_U' P Q)
equation_mapping.explanation: The circuit is the factorization U = Q^T P^T U' P Q, with Q, P and U' obtained from _search and compiled exactly.
U' = (PQ) U (PQ)^T is computed by successive basis-permutation conjugations: first the Q XOR mask, then the P transpositions.
A greedy heuristic, not an exact argmin: the entry-count proxy plus a permutation cost (popcount of the XOR mask, 1 per transposition). Q is searched over XOR masks and P over transpositions.
Time order is Q, P (T_1..T_s), C_U', P^T (T_s..T_1), Q^T. C_U' is an exact two-level decomposition: the diagonal first, then G_m^dag ... G_1^dag.

The |0...0> input is prepared by the runner, and the global-phase comparison with U is a validation criterion. The circuit itself is a bare operation with no state preparation. The little-endian convention is used in all index arithmetic.

specification_changes.change: Q is restricted to XOR-mask permutations k -> k XOR m (cost popcount(m)). P is a sequence of basis transpositions found greedily, each costing 1, and a swap is accepted only if the entry count drops by at least 2. The search is not an exact minimization.
specification_changes.reason: The abstract gives no explicit search or cost. A cheap, well-defined heuristic stands in for OptQC.

specification_changes.change: U' is compiled by a two-level Givens decomposition with multi-controlled U/phase gates instead of the Qcompiler decomposition.
specification_changes.reason: The Qcompiler internals are unspecified and the circuit must use only standard gates, with no opaque dense unitary.

specification_changes.change: Scope is narrowed to n in 1..4 qubits with an explicit unitary supplied as instance fields n, unitary_real and optional unitary_imag. No gate-count savings are claimed. MPI parallelism and the 'each matrix component separately' idea are not implemented.
specification_changes.reason: The dense classical processing grows as 4^n and the specification only requires tiny instances.

specification_changes.change: The initial state |0...0> is not prepared and no measurement is performed.
specification_changes.reason: The task requires an operation only. The runner prepares inputs and compares the unitary or statevector with U up to global phase.

assumptions: The instance supplies U explicitly and it is unitary to within 1e-8.
Little-endian basis index convention: qubit j holds bit j of the basis index.
Qiskit controlled-UGate and mcp implement the intended controlled operations, including the separately applied controlled global phase of each 2x2 block.
The cost proxy counts off-diagonal entries with magnitude above 1e-9, and the Givens elimination skips entries below 1e-12.
P = Q = I is possible (no swaps and a zero mask) when the greedy search finds no improvement.
unresolved_issues: The exact OptQC search algorithm and cost function remain unknown, so the permutations found may differ from the paper's.
The Qcompiler decomposition is replaced by a generic Givens decomposition whose gate count is not optimized.
The precise meaning of 'equivalent up to a permutation' and 'components considered separately' beyond the similarity form is not modeled.
Cost grows quickly with n, so only n<=4 is allowed, and no numerical verification has been performed at generation time.

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
